| # Diagnostics services (UDS) in Bootloader {#diagnostics-services-uds-in-bootloader-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                      |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This chapter provides an overview of the Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS) implemented within the Bootloader environment based on the ISO 14229-1.

It outlines the supported UDS services, the security levels governing access to these services and all the accessible Data Identifiers (DIDs), including their session and security prerequisites.
